actions.mechanism: Traverse IDs present at a committed version fence; exclude later insertions and return deletion markers for later deletions.
actions.implementation: Persist birth/death versions and tombstones. Serialize commit-fence publication. Sign ten-minute cursors containing fence and last (creation timestamp, ID); use indexed keyset queries.
actions.check: Under concurrent churn, compare collected IDs against fence membership: zero duplicates or omissions. Require every request below 300 ms.
actions.risk: Version filtering may scan excessively; deployment requires latency validation. Contents are not snapshotted.

actions.mechanism: A session traverses exactly its pinned root’s IDs, independently of subsequent changes to live membership.
actions.implementation: Maintain a copy-on-write ordered membership tree in the existing store; atomically publish roots with writes. Retain pinned nodes ten minutes; reject expired cursors.
actions.check: Insert and delete between pages; require collected IDs equal the pinned set without duplicates, and every request below 300 ms.
actions.risk: Adds write amplification and garbage collection. Deleted IDs return markers; surviving records expose current contents.
